lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Cold drizzle turns Thornwick's market square into churned ochre paste as watch-bells clang from the river gate.

lines.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
lines.line: Three patrols overdue from Sunken Ford, and now smoke's rising off the tollhouse roof.

lines.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
lines.line: The capital sent ceremonial plumes instead of arrowheads, Garrick. Half my pikes are bent plowshares.

lines.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
lines.line: Keep your men out of the black reeds if they take a scratch—gnoll iron is greased with fen-rot.

lines.speaker: npc-fenwick-ferryman
lines.line: River's running red past my eel-weirs. Somebody paid good silver to put warbands on the north road.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Count the dry bowstrings and muster whoever can still march. We take the ford before noon.

lines.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
lines.line: You heard the commander. Check your cinch-straps—nobody gets buried on company time.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Iron-shod boots splash through the southern postern as crows lift lazily from the palisade stakes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Ashbrook's splintered gatehouse smolders against a bruised twilight as handcarts creak south toward the boundary obelisk.

lines.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
lines.line: Vaelen's banners are broken, though half the town is packed onto three wagons with nothing but seed-corn.

lines.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
lines.line: Morvessa's hex-writs were stamped at the Border Mint. This wasn't a border raid—it was a foreclosure.

lines.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
lines.line: Pack extra rivets and lamp oil. Redmarsh alkali eats honest iron faster than a rust-mite.

lines.speaker: npc-fenwick-ferryman
lines.line: My punt stops at the boundary stone. Beyond here, all the rivers died five hundred years ago.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Burn what we cannot haul and double the outriders. Morvessa went south, and we follow.

lines.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
lines.line: Forward march. Keep your canteens covered and your shields high.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Behind the column, Thornwick's distant watchtowers gutter out in the drizzle as red dust rises ahead.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Heat shimmers off rust-red salt pans where Redmarsh Outpost leans crookedly on oak pilings.

lines.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
lines.line: Welcome to the bottom of a dead sea. Water is four silver a gill, and shade costs extra.

lines.speaker: npc-tull-water-seller
lines.line: Do not drink from unsealed troughs—desert clans poison the wells with scorpion-bile before retreating.

lines.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
lines.line: Someone is cracking the plateau wardstones to the east. If those quartz spires rupture, the alkali swallows the passes.

lines.speaker: field-warden-hale
lines.line: Sand-raiders hold the Twin Passes with horn-bows, and my vanguard scouts are pinned in Bracken Basin.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Open the causeway first, pull Hale's scouts out of the scrub, and secure the wardstones.

lines.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
lines.line: Bring back any intact brass valves you find—my mules are hauling empty barrels.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: A dry copper wind rattles bleached ribs along the causeway as the vanguard steps onto the salt crust.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Rusted sluice-wheels shriek open atop Ironheart Bastion, revealing empty silt beds below and grey surf beyond.

lines.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
lines.line: Forty years guarding dry cisterns. Gorrathul starved a province to protect an empty bucket.

lines.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
lines.line: His last words confirmed it: Morvessa's sea-galleys are already massing along the Iron Coast.

lines.speaker: npc-tull-water-seller
lines.line: Drink a pint of coastal rainwater for me when you reach Oakhaven. I've forgotten how water tastes without chalk.

lines.speaker: field-miner-tomas
lines.line: The Deep Quarry is flooded and our chains are broken. My lads will march with you down to the sea.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Raise our banner on the high parapet so the rear guard sees the pass is clear. We descend at dawn.

lines.speaker: field-warden-hale
lines.line: Watch the switchbacks—salt gales peel careless men straight off the scree.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Far below the forked peak, black smoke curls upward from Harborwatch's distant bay.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Salt rot and wet pine smoke cling to Oakhaven's palisades while ironclad hulks block the grey harbor channel.

lines.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
lines.line: Six weeks without launching a keel, and now Vesperion's privateers are burning our marsh jetties.

lines.speaker: npc-lyra-warden
lines.line: The city council hoards crossbows behind bolted doors while my pickets throw roof-slates from the seawall.

lines.speaker: npc-sera-healer
lines.line: Half my surgical tents are full of lung-blisters from those Cinder Wards on the cliffs.

lines.speaker: npc-pip-mudlark
lines.line: Low tide bares the sunken causeway, boss—lots of shiny rings if the salt crabs don't nip your toes off!

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Break the channel blockade first. Once Kors's drydocks open, we push up the coast road.

lines.speaker: npc-lyra-warden
lines.line: Clear those mudflats and every marine in Oakhaven marches under your pennant.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Foghorns groan across the Greywash estuary as heavy boots splash onto the tidal plank-walks.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Admiral Kael's flagship settles beneath boiling black foam, trailing gold braid and burning whale-oil.

lines.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
lines.line: Half the fleet is charred timber, captain, yet twelve patched carracks float ready for the crossing.

lines.speaker: npc-sera-healer
lines.line: Load the vinegar casks and clean bandages below decks—nothing grows across those volcanic straits.

lines.speaker: npc-lyra-warden
lines.line: Oakhaven's seawalls are secure. My archers have dry bowstrings and a score to settle in the ash.

lines.speaker: npc-pip-mudlark
lines.line: Take my lucky granite pebble for the fire-mountain, boss. It probably won't melt right away.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Cast off on the noon tide. Every debt sworn since Thornwick waits across that water.

lines.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
lines.line: All hands to the halyards! Keep your eyes on the red glare beneath the clouds.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Compass needles spin wildly and lock due south as the fleet clears Harborwatch's scorched breakwater.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Black glass sand crunches underfoot as grey cinders drift down from a sky without sun or stars.

lines.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
lines.line: Welcome to Ironcamp. The air tastes like sulfur, and the sniper-fiends on the ridge shoot anything that salutes.

lines.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
lines.line: Normal steel turns soft as tallow in this heat. Stick your blades in my floor-fissures before we march.

lines.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
lines.line: Arch-Mage Malrik flees toward the summit portal with the desecration codices, while Ashkarath guards the Anchor Seals.

lines.speaker: field-ash-scout
lines.line: Stay off the yellow crust—boiling sulfur sits two inches beneath that brittle shell.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Shatter the focusing beacons, break the Gauntlet, and take the Threshold before their reserves muster.

lines.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
lines.line: No banners, no speeches—just shields and spite. Move out.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Trip-hammers thunder behind the vanguard as the column steps onto the scorched basalt highway.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Inside the Obsidian Dais, sluggish magma stills like cooling tallow as the final Anchor Seal fractures.

lines.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
lines.line: The old penitence is ended. Look up—the ash-clouds are parting for the first time in living memory.

lines.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
lines.line: The world's anvil has finally cooled enough to hold an honest edge.

lines.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
lines.line: Four provinces bled to reach these steps, commander. Give the word and the banners stand down.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Send riders to every garrison from Thornwick to Harborwatch. The war is over; the reckoning begins.

lines.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
lines.line: May whatever rule follows remember the weight of the iron that bought it.

lines.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
lines.line: Sound the recall horns. Let the men wash the ash from their faces.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Far beyond the cooling straits, northern watchtowers kindle their beacons one by one in pale silver dawn.
